storyCards.headline: Georgy Girl: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Seekers's "Georgy Girl" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Georgy Girl" is a song by the Australian pop/folk music group the Seekers.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

Georgy Girl was released in 1967.
